$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoDescription: Search 2,900+ SmartRecruiters companies at once: titles, places, remote and hybrid work, job types, pay and exact posting times. Newest first, no login.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Measured on Apify on 2026-11-03 (build 1.0.1 on engine v0.4.0, unpriced): the example input took 40.7 s at 2048 MB with a peak of 104 MB and $0.0056 of platform usage (run T1JjpjZvjP6XS2NFm); at 1024 MB it took 112 s, peak 106 MB, $0.0075 (ffqkndjmBbL0rfgl8), and the empty form 107 s, peak 79 MB, $0.0072 (hx5pj1xNsf5tKA7YI). A quarter core makes the pass CPU-bound on Apify (the average call went from 0.35 s to 2.02 s), so 2 GB is the cheaper and 2.8x faster choice: the default stays 2048 here and in tasks.json options. The laptop's estimate that 1 GB would cost no more did not hold there. The empty form was not run at 2048 MB; at 1024 MB it took 107 s against the example's 112 s, so expect about 40 s. Every job (maxJobs 0) peaked at 685 MB locally, because the search holds every match to sort them newest first: minMemoryMbytes stays 1024 for that. Since engine v0.4.1 the details of such a run are read and let go 500 rows at a time, so they add one chunk of descriptions, not all of them. Apify's daily test runs the empty form and must finish in 300 s.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16 and the batch brief section 8; users and FREE-tier prices from GET /v2/acts/<user>~<name> the same day. Main competitor by 30-day users for a SmartRecruiters job: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api, 1,632 u30, $0.012 a row plus $0.01 a run, a stored database of 58 ATS where smartrecruiters is one filter. It is absent from the Store's 82 results for 'smartrecruiters', and its own feed sells the same rows at $0.0025 plus $0.10 a run, so it is not the anchor. The anchor for the same job, a SmartRecruiters row with its description from one keyword across every company: jobo.world at $0.004 (ats-jobs-api 134 u30; smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper-api 5 u30, #1 to #3 for 'smartrecruiters', 'smartrecruiters scraper' and 'smartrecruiters jobs api'), beside memo23/career-site-ats-jobs-api $0.004 plus $0.03 (81 u30) and hirebase $0.005 plus $0.001 (137 u30). job-details $0.0035 is 12.5% under $0.004; job $0.0025 is a list row with no description and no pay, as deel-jobs-search prices it. Cheaper for companies you already know: bovi $0.0015 (100 u30), memo23/smartrecruiters-scraper $0.0009 plus $0.025 (3 u30). No start fee. Measured on Apify at the default 2 GB (run T1JjpjZvjP6XS2NFm, build 1.0.1, 2026-11-03): a one-keyword 100-row run used $0.0056 of platform usage, 2.8% of the $0.20 its rows earn after Apify's 20%, for a margin of 97.2% on FREE and 97.6% on GOLD (0.8 x revenue minus platform cost). Each keyword is its own pass over every site: five keywords took 14,844 calls for the same 100 rows (locally, 2026-11-03), 4.8 times the 3,070 calls of one, so about $0.027 at 2 GB by that scale (not run on Apify), more than a tenth of what those rows earn (SEO.md 16.4). The loss case is a filter that matches nothing, which reads every page (7,148 calls locally, about $0.013 by the same scale) and earns nothing. Decision of 2026-11-03 after the measurement: prices unchanged, no start event. apify-actor-start is charged before the input is read, so it would also charge runs that end with nothing, and a start event charged after the first read needs the shared engine. Start high while private: a cut is free, a raise costs a month. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, location, work type, job type, department, posting date, job and apply links. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay with its currency and period, reference number, city, region, country and country code.
